video_title: 2026-27 Training Camp Media Availability 🎙️ | Jaylen Brown | 10.01.26

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on building chemistry and learning the 76ers system
quotes.excerpt: everyone just getting acclimated to one another. I'm just getting acclimated to the building, to the staff
quotes.quote: Everyone just getting acclimated to one another. I'm just getting acclimated to the building, to the staff, and just getting the system downloaded. Everything just downloading all the information. A lot of the guys, a lot of the guys have been great at just communicating and making everybody be on the same page.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says he is currently focused on getting acclimated to the 76ers building and downloading the team system during his first few days of training camp

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown praises Tyrese Maxey's leadership and communication skills
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese just been a great communicator and he's just been leading with his voice early on.
quotes.quote: Tyrese just been a great communicator and he's just been leading with his voice early on. He's gone out of his way to make sure that I feel comfortable in the system, which goes a long way. He doesn't have to do that. I'm the type of guy that I'll figure it out regardless, but for him to be trying to make sure I feel welcome, I think I've appreciated it.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown is already impressed by Tyrese Maxey as a leader saying he has been a great communicator and has gone out of his way to make sure Brown feels comfortable in the new system

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on establishing team roles and accountability during training camp
quotes.excerpt: identifying what our jobs are, what our roles are, and that we can hold each other accountable too.
quotes.quote: Just being on the same page, identifying what our jobs are, what our roles are, and that we can hold each other accountable too. I think just establishing that is the most important thing. What's the foundation? What's our core values? What are we not giving up? Little stuff like that is what we're just establishing the foundation here at training camp.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says the primary focus for the 76ers at training camp is establishing the foundation and core values of the team

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on finding offensive balance with Joel Embiid and LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: we try to establish some spacing, we try to establish what positions on the floor
quotes.quote: We try to establish some spacing, we try to establish what positions on the floor and the style of play. I think we're still kind of figuring that out. I think I am when to go, when not to go on the floor when big fellas are going down the post or when I can put some pressure on the rim. Just trying to find that balance, I think we're only three days in, so it may take a little bit of time, but I'm looking forward to the journey.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown on finding offensive balance with Joel Embiid and LeBron James: We are still figuring out the spacing and style of play but I am looking forward to the journey

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on Nick Nurse's defensive-minded coaching style
quotes.excerpt: Nick has been a guy that he's defensive-minded first, playing hard, non-negotiable.
quotes.quote: Nick has been a guy that he's defensive-minded first, playing hard, non-negotiable. A lot of his teams, a lot of his guys play very hard, very physical. So it's been no different being in training camp, establishing that physicality, that style of play, that defensive pressure, and then on offense being able to find spacing and then kind of establish and implement our system from there. But I think most importantly, I think we've focused on defense the first couple days and I like that because I think that's where the game is going to be won or lost for us on defense.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says Nick Nurse is prioritizing defense first in training camp noting that for the team the game is going to be won or lost on the defensive end

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown emphasizes defensive communication as the team's top priority
quotes.excerpt: defensively, I think that's where we really got to make sure we hang our hat on
quotes.quote: Defensively, I think that's where we really got to make sure we hang our hat on each and every night. Can't get so caught up in worried about how the offense is going. Got to make sure clear communication, identifying coverages, and holding each other accountable and getting back on defense as well. So we've been working on that and that'll be the part where it's like it's a whole new system, whole new calls. I got to like download my brain, different algorithm to make sure I'm not calling the wrong stuff because the names are different.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown admits he is currently learning a whole new defensive system and terminology saying I got to download my brain with a different algorithm to make sure I am not calling the wrong stuff

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on building chemistry with LeBron James and Tyrese Maxey
quotes.excerpt: just one pace and then two just, you know, just building some chemistry, different spots on the floor
quotes.quote: Just one pace and then two just, you know, just building some chemistry, different spots on the floor where we like to get the ball to. Like using Maxey's speed, LeBron, him at the elbow being able to make plays, make reads. He's great at that picking apart defenses and stuff like that. Me getting into my spots to the elbows, using my mid-range ability. So just seeing where our superpowers, where everybody's great at and kind of finding ways that we can naturally flow to those things.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown on the new 76ers offense: We are looking at using Maxey's speed and LeBron at the elbow to make reads while I use my mid-range ability to find our superpowers

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on handling adversity and trusting the process
quotes.excerpt: how we handle adversity is what I'm looking forward to because how you respond to those moments
quotes.quote: How we handle adversity is what I'm looking forward to because how you respond to those moments is just determines what type of team you are. So, you know, just preparing for that. I know the fans are excited, but, you know, it takes time to build that chemistry, takes time to build that relationship with each other. And just, I guess, what y'all, everybody always says around here, trust the process.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says he is looking forward to seeing how the new look 76ers handle adversity adding that it takes time to build chemistry and trust the process

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the importance of an open relationship with his coach
quotes.excerpt: I prefer to be coached, so being able to have an open relationship
quotes.quote: I prefer to be coached, so being able to have an open relationship, kind of seeing what he's seeing even going into practices and stuff like that, what he wants to, what do we need to get out of the group and trying to just be an echo for him on the floor. So, having a great relationship with the head coach is important to me.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown emphasizes the importance of having an open relationship with his head coach saying I prefer to be coached and want to be an echo for him on the floor

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the challenges of moving to a new city
quotes.excerpt: first I got to set my feet, you know, get settled, getting all my stuff moved over
quotes.quote: First I got to set my feet, you know, get settled, getting all my stuff moved over from Boston still, getting used to the facility, getting used to all the coverages. And then you can start to, you know, expand out where you're starting to work with younger guys and that help help others be in the right position and stuff like that. But, you know, first I got to get myself settled in.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says he is still in the process of moving his life from Boston to Philadelphia as he gets settled into the new facility

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on Tyrese Maxey's role as a leader and host
quotes.excerpt: Tyrese has been a great leader. He's been a great host.
quotes.quote: Tyrese has been a great leader. He's been a great host. Obviously, he's been here for a long time, but he's been the most vocal and he's been the one kind of making sure everybody is kind of accommodated. He's over-emphasized. He's tried to make me feel comfortable even if I didn't, I don't need it. But I appreciated it though. Tyrese has been the most accommodating, you know, he's been a great host.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown says Tyrese Maxey has been the most vocal leader and the best host during his transition to the 76ers
